# cubepath_ddos_protected_ips (Data Source)

Lists the organization's IP addresses with Premium DDoS protection, the ones a cubepath_ddos_protection_profile can be set on. IPv4 subnets are expanded to their addresses.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `ips` (Attributes List) Protected IP addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ips))

<a id="nestedatt--ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ips`

Read-Only:

- `firewall_rules_count` (Number) Number of DDoS firewall rules on the address.
- `has_profile` (Boolean) Whether a protection profile is set.
- `ip_address` (String) IP address.
- `ip_type` (String) IPv4 or IPv6.
- `location_name` (String) Location of the IP.
- `protection_type` (String) Premium or Premium Always-On.
- `subnet` (String) Subnet the address belongs to, in CIDR notation, when it comes from a protected subnet.
